whyUs.label: Why us
whyUs.description: Most agencies optimize for their own convenience and bill you for it. Here is how we have decided to work instead, in writing.

tech.title: Best tech for your needs, not ours
tech.description: We pick the stack that fits your project and the people who will maintain it, not the one we happen to be fastest at. You never pay for our habits.

demos.title: Weekly live demos and updates
demos.description: Every week you get a working build to click through and a plain-English rundown of what changed. No month-long silences. No surprise invoices.

live.title: Live platform from day one
live.description: Your platform ships to production with the first build. You watch it grow feature by feature instead of waiting for one big reveal at the end.

lean.title: Build only what you will use
lean.description: We cut anything that does not earn its place. No bloated feature lists you will never open, just the things your users actually reach for.

feedback.title: Your feedback shapes everything
feedback.description: Your input drives every decision. We do not disappear for months. You are part of the process from day one.

howWeWork.label: How we work
howWeWork.description: No confusing process, no project-management jargon. Just straightforward.

first.title: First call
first.description: Tell us about your vision. What are you building? Who is it for? What is holding you back right now? We listen first.

plan.title: Plan the next feature
plan.description: We work with you to decide what to build next. What matters most? What will make the biggest difference for your learners?

design.title: Design it
design.description: We design how it looks and how it works. You see exactly what it will be before we write a single line of code.

build.title: Build it
build.description: We bring it to life. We handle the heavy lifting and make sure everything works the way it should.

demo.title: Demo it
demo.description: We give you a live version to play with. Test it, break it, tell us what feels right and what does not.

launch.title: Launch it
launch.description: We ship it to your platform. Your users get it.

homeServices.label: Services
homeServices.description: We build exactly what you need. No templates. No compromises.

homeFaq.label: FAQ
homeFaq.description: Everything you need to know about working with us. Still curious? Just ask, we are happy to get specific.

timeline.question: How quickly can you build our platform?
timeline.answer: It depends on scope, but here is how we approach timelines. We break everything into weekly sprints with live demos, so you see real progress every week instead of vague updates. Most platforms launch in phases: core features first (usually 8 to 12 weeks), then we iterate and add more based on what you learn from real users. You get a clear roadmap after our first conversation.

involvement.question: How involved will we be during development?
involvement.answer: Very. Every week you see what has been built, test it live, and give feedback that shapes the next sprint. This is not a disappear-for-months-then-surprise-you situation. You are part of the process from day one.

integrations.question: Can you integrate with our existing tools?
integrations.answer: Yes. Payment gateways, CRMs, email platforms, Zoom, Google Meet, SSO, whatever you currently use gets connected. We build around your workflow, not against it.

afterLaunch.question: What happens after we launch?
afterLaunch.answer: Launch is the beginning, not the end. We offer optional maintenance contracts for ongoing support, updates, new features, and optimizations. Most clients stay with us long-term because their platform keeps evolving with their needs.

scale.question: Will the platform scale as we grow?
scale.answer: That is the plan. We architect for growth from day one. Whether you are at 500 learners or 50,000, the infrastructure supports it, and we adjust as you scale.

mobile.question: Is the platform mobile-friendly?
mobile.answer: Completely. It works on desktop, tablet, and mobile, responsive by default rather than as an afterthought.

ownership.question: Who owns the code and platform?
ownership.answer: You do. Full ownership transfers to you on final payment: the code, the platform, the infrastructure. Maintenance is optional, never required.
